reader.requirement: At --std 85 each USING parameter (BY REFERENCE or BY CONTENT identifier, including subscripted, reference-modified and variable-length group operands) must be made available to the called program with the value it has when the CALL executes, the BY REFERENCE operand's location fixed at that point and the BY CONTENT copy taken at that point; the 2002 forms (literal or figurative arguments, BY VALUE, OMITTED) must be refused.

reader.notes: The emitted CALL evaluates each operand's place (subscripts, reference modification, ODO length) and takes BY CONTENT copies before Activate transfers control. All probes matched the 1985 text.

K=4' (BY CONTENT values and the BY REFERENCE location taken when the CALL executed). r10b_commarg.cob: a Communication Section item (admitted by the 1985 SR3) delivered: 'SUB L=0007 ... MAIN OC=0008'.
